value.rationale: A natural two-direction grid diffusion graph has a complete, sharp parameter-space classification for positivity of a widely used fourth-order endpoint integrator. It identifies the only five graph shapes admitting all-step positivity, proves exact admissible rate intervals, and shows directional anisotropy rescues \(K_2\square K_5\), a behavior absent from the equal-rate graph. The invariant is directly useful for assessing whether rate tuning alone can avoid endpoint negativity.
